ourStory.title: OUR STORY
ourStory.intro: Kamancha, in the heart of Yerevan, was founded in 2019 with the idea of bringing Armenian cuisine and traditional music together under one roof.
ourStory.introSecond: In our kitchen, traditional recipes from across Armenia meet innovative approaches, preserving the authenticity of Armenian flavours while revealing them anew. Live national music completes the experience, turning every visit into an encounter with Armenian culture.

tumanyan.title: Tumanyan 23
tumanyan.body: is where we created a space in which Armenian flavours, music and warm hospitality intertwine, making every visit a complete Armenian experience.

saryan.title: Saryan 8
saryan.body: is where Kamancha Tapaka Rooms presents a new take on Armenian cuisine, paired with wine culture and Kamancha hospitality.

delivery.title: Kamancha Factory
delivery.body: is Kamancha's dedicated delivery arm, created to meet our guests' high demand and make favourite dishes more accessible. Delivery covers all of Yerevan, every day from 10:00 to 00:00.

founder.title: Areg Gevorgyan
founder.body: is an Armenian restaurateur, entrepreneur and founding director of the Kamancha restaurants and the Restormania and Pideh projects, focused on developing the restaurant business, Armenian gastronomy and hospitality.
